purpose.domain_detail: HR/personnel management system - printing/processing employment contract entry forms for employees, handling career records, presence tracking, and contract notifications. French-language (Belgian or Swiss) enterprise HR application.
purpose.summary: This program (3-ENTREE) handles the entry and printing of employment contracts ('ENTREE' = entry/contract). It reads employee registry records, career data, presence records, and contract records, then calls a configurable print model (MODELE) to produce contract documents. It supports filtering by status and cost center, and tracks notification dates on contracts.

notable_features: USE AFTER ERROR DECLARATIVES with C$RERR
Dynamic CALL using variable MODELE (configurable print model)
22 COPY statements for modular record/routine includes
LINKAGE SECTION with LINK-V parameter block
EVALUATE used extensively for screen field dispatch
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 which explains the box-drawing characters in comments (CP850/latin-1 mixed). The program is part of a larger HR suite with many shared copybooks. The 'online-cics' program_type label is approximate - this is actually a screen-based interactive program using Micro Focus/AcuCOBOL screen I/O extensions, not CICS. No EXEC CICS found. The MODELE variable ('DEF' default) suggests pluggable report modules.
